rates.verification: All ten 2026 decisions verified; none held for lack of verification. CBRT: each press release read directly on www.tcmb.gov.tr on 2026-10-23 (rates, overnight lending and borrowing rates), cross-checked with the listed secondary sources. FOMC: each statement was verified from the federalreserve.gov text returned by web search restricted to that domain (statement, implementation note, minutes), cross-checked with the listed sources. Fed changes take effect the day after the decision as in rates_band.py; with no 2026 change this does not matter.
rates.audit_note: Independent audit, 2026-10-23: every 2026 rate re-verified. CBRT ANO2026-01, -12, -17, -23 and -28 read directly on www.tcmb.gov.tr (37% after 22 Jan, overnight lending/borrowing 40/35.5); ANO2026-11 (1 Mar 2026, one-week repo auctions suspended) and ANO2026-35 (23 Aug 2026, auctions resumed) also read directly. FOMC: all five 2026 statements to July confirmed at 3-1/2 to 3-3/4 percent via federalreserve.gov-restricted search; the April vote note was corrected to list all four dissents. The CBRT 'Monetary Policy for 2026' text dates the 2025 suspension 20 March - 17 April 2025. Rates, estimates and all other outputs unchanged by the audit.

effective_funding_episodes.note: interim MPC of 20 Mar 2025 raised the overnight lending rate to 46% and suspended one-week repo auctions; the TCMB 'Monetary Policy for 2026' text dates the suspension 20 March - 17 April 2025; from 17 Apr 2025 the policy rate is 46% (rates_band.py), so the path is unchanged from that date

one-week repo auctions suspended (press release of 1 Mar 2026; 'suspended as of March 2' and 'average funding cost to stand at 40%, which is the CBRT's overnight lending rate' in the MPC summary of 18 Mar 2026); resumption decided 23 Aug 2026, first auction (at 37%) on 24 Aug 2026

rates.effective_funding_caveat: supplementary path. The 2026 episode is documented by CBRT releases (ANO2026-35 and the 18 Mar 2026 MPC summary were read directly; ANO2026-11 returned HTTP 503 and its text was confirmed via search). The 2025 episode is from search-indexed TCMB text (direct fetches returned 503): if overnight funding at 49% continued after 17 Apr 2025, this path understates that carry by 3 pp (0.8 bp per day).

sign_check.reading: premium level lower by 2.4 bp per extra carry day and +4.1 bp jump per carry day lost at a roll: the measured premium is lower on multi-carry dates, so x_adj = x + g (n - 1) with g > 0 raises it
